SELECTED_INDEX: 1
CONFIDENCE: 0.62
EXPLANATION: The very strong band at 2266 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of a C≡N stretch; a geminal dicyano group (two C≡N on the same carbon) as in candidate 1 commonly yields a single intense ν(C≡N) in this region. The fingerprint region supports a cyclic ether: prominent bands at 939 and 898 cm⁻¹ (ring-breathing/CC–O modes) and at 720 cm⁻¹ (ring deformation) together with strong C–O–C stretching features at 1028–1060 cm⁻¹ and CH₂/CH₃ deformations at 1462–1475 cm⁻¹ match an oxetane/ether ring environment. Alternatives are less consistent: isocyanide (6) would shift the ≡NC stretch to ~2140–2160 cm⁻¹; the thioether dinitrile (3) would emphasize C–S modes near ~650–750 cm⁻¹ without the strong ~900–950 cm⁻¹ ether-like bands; P–H containing candidates (10, 5) would require PH stretches near 2300–2420 cm⁻¹ without a nitrile at 2266. The features at 2380 and 3208 cm⁻¹ are plausibly ambient (e.g., PH/air/water) and do not contradict the assignment.
